title: mesh-bus-egress-socks5
description: Config for a SOCKS5 upstream egress exit. Constructed by mesh-bus-runtime from EgressCfg::Socks5 (stream CONNECT) or EgressCfg::Socks5Udp (datagram UDP ASSOCIATE). Both share id/upstream/timeout_ms/auth; the stream and datagram semantic constants below describe the two capability shapes.

id.description: Unique ExitId for this egress within the bus.

timeout_ms.description: Connect, handshake, and write timeout in milliseconds. Upstream reads are continuous byte-stream forwarding, not request-response reads.

stream_model.description: SOCKS5 CONNECT egress treats post-handshake bytes as an RFC-aligned bidirectional byte stream. send() writes client bytes; poll() returns independently produced upstream chunks.

close_semantics.description: Close and Cancel frames remove the cached per-session upstream stream without SOCKS5 read/write.

shutdown_write_semantics.description: ShutdownWrite shuts down only the upstream SOCKS5 TCP write half and leaves the read half available for return streaming.

udp_associate_model.description: EgressCfg::Socks5Udp binds one local UDP socket, opens a TCP control connection, runs the same NoAuth/RFC1929 handshake, sends UDP ASSOCIATE with the local bind address as DST, and parses the ATYP-aware BND reply as the UDP relay endpoint. If BND.ADDR is unspecified the control peer IP is substituted with BND.PORT.

datagram_boundary.description: Each DatagramSession::send_to is wrapped with the SOCKS5 UDP request header (RSV RSV FRAG=0 + ATYP target) and emitted as exactly one UDP datagram to the relay; recv_from decodes exactly one relayed datagram back to (target, payload).

control_close_semantics.description: DatagramSession::close drops the retained TCP control connection, which per RFC1928 terminates the UDP association; the relay stops forwarding for this session.

auth.description: Optional RFC1929 user/pass credentials for upstream SOCKS5 authentication. Absent means NoAuth only. Present means the greeting offers UserPass+NoAuth and the upstream may run user/pass subnegotiation. Applies to both Socks5 and Socks5Udp.
